catalog.name: Name
catalog.translationNameMissing: Please translate the name as well.

products.title: Products
products.description: One product list for the POS register, QR menu and web. Changes apply immediately on all channels.
products.newHint: Add variants, allergens, translations and everything else afterwards in the product.
products.needTaxCategory: There is no tax category yet. Please set up VAT first.
products.noLocation: Choose a location at the top to mark products as sold out (“86”).
products.empty: No products yet. Create the first product.

productEditor.duplicated: Copy created. It is still inactive.
productEditor.deleteText: The product disappears from the POS register, QR menu and web. Past orders and receipts keep it.
productEditor.readOnly: You can view this product but not change it.
productEditor.noPricePermission: Changing prices requires the “Change prices” permission.

basics.title: Basics
basics.hint: Apply to all locations and channels.
basics.descriptionHint: Appears in the QR menu and on the web.
basics.taxCategoryHint: Determines the VAT rate together with the channel and consumption type (dine-in, takeaway).
basics.basePriceHint: Catalogue price. Channel and location prices under “Prices & variants”.
basics.basePriceVariants: With variants, the price of the default variant applies.
basics.defaultCourseHint: Suggested when ordering; can be changed at the POS register.
basics.sortOrderHint: Lower number = higher up in the category.
basics.imageUrlHint: Image for the QR menu and web (https://…).
basics.isActiveHint: Inactive products appear neither at the POS register nor in the QR menu or on the web.
basics.requiresOriginHint: If so, the origin is required for the QR menu and web.

publication.title: Publication
publication.hint: The POS register shows every active product. The QR menu and web only show it once the allergens are checked and, for meat, poultry or fish, the origin is stated.
publication.blocked: Not ready for the QR menu and web yet: {issues}.
publication.missingTitle: Still missing for the QR menu and web:

issueHints.allergens_missing: Record the allergens and confirm with “Allergens checked”.
issueHints.origin_missing: State the country of origin of the meat, poultry or fish.

publication.ready: Allergens and origin are complete. The product can appear in the QR menu and on the web.

variants.title: Variants
variants.hint: Sizes or measures with their own price, e.g. 3 dl and 5 dl. The catalogue price follows the default variant.
variants.empty: No variants: the price from Basics applies.
variants.name: Label

channelPrices.title: Prices per channel
channelPrices.hint: Optionally a different price for a channel, for all locations or one location, and for a variant. On that channel it replaces the catalogue or variant price.
channelPrices.empty: No channel prices: all channels use the catalogue price.
channelPrices.duplicate: Only one price per channel, location and variant.

locationSettings.noLocation: Choose a location at the top to edit activation, price and “86” for that location.
locationSettings.title: At location {location}
locationSettings.hint: Each location can deactivate the product or set its own price.
locationSettings.activeHint: When deactivated, the product doesn’t appear on any channel at this location.

productModifiers.title: Modifiers
productModifiers.hint: Groups that are asked when ordering, in this order (e.g. doneness, side dish).

productAllergens.title: Allergens
productAllergens.hint: The 14 allergens that must be declared. They appear at the POS register, in the QR menu, on the web and on the kitchen ticket.
productAllergens.confirmedHint: Confirm even if the product contains no allergens. Without confirmation, it doesn’t appear in the QR menu or on the web.
productAllergens.notConfirmed: Not confirmed yet: the product doesn’t appear in the QR menu or on the web.

origins.title: Origin
origins.hint: Country of origin of meat, poultry and fish, shown in the digital and printed menu.
origins.required: The product contains meat, poultry or fish: the origin is required for the QR menu and web. Can be set in Basics.
origins.notRequired: The origin isn’t required for this product. If it contains meat, poultry or fish, enable this in Basics.

productTranslations.title: Translations
productTranslations.hint: Name and description in the menu languages. An empty language shows the text in the location language, otherwise “{name}”.

availability.title: Availability
availability.hint: By weekday, time of day (e.g. breakfast, lunch, dinner), channel, location and period.
availability.alwaysAvailable: Without rules, the product is always available.
availability.onlyWhenMatching: The product can only be ordered when at least one rule matches.

problems.bothTimes: Enter both From and To, or leave both empty.
problems.sameTimes: From and To must be different.

productStations.title: Kitchen stations at location {location}
productStations.hint: Where the product’s ticket goes. Several stations are possible, e.g. grill and garnish.
productStations.noLocation: Choose a location at the top to assign kitchen stations.
productStations.noStations: This location has no kitchen stations yet.
productStations.none: No station selected yet. Every product needs at least one station for the kitchen ticket.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Structure the POS register, QR menu and web. An inactive category hides all its products.
categories.listHint: Subcategories are indented below their parent category.
categories.parentHint: For subcategories, e.g. Wines › Red wines.
categories.imageUrlHint: Image for the QR menu and web (https://…).
categories.activeHint: Inactive hides the category and all its products on all channels.
categories.deleteText: Only empty categories can be removed.
categories.deleteHasProducts: {count, plural, one {The category still contains one product.} other {The category still contains # products.}} Move the products first or deactivate the category.
categories.notEmpty: The category still contains products or subcategories. Move them first or deactivate the category.
categories.translationsHint: An empty language shows the name in the location language or the catalogue text.

modifiers.title: Modifiers
modifiers.description: Required and optional groups with minimum and maximum selection and a surcharge, e.g. doneness or side dish.
modifiers.groupsHint: A group with a minimum selection above 0 is required when ordering.
modifiers.newHint: Add the options to the group afterwards.
modifiers.deleteText: Only possible if no product uses the group. Past orders keep their options.
modifiers.inUse: Products still use this group. Remove it from the products first or deactivate the group.
modifiers.requiredHint: {count, plural, one {Required: at least one option.} other {Required: at least # options.}}
modifiers.maxHint: The maximum number of options that can be chosen.
modifiers.readOnly: You can view this group but not change it.
modifiers.groupHint: Name and selection rules apply to all products with this group.
modifiers.activeHint: Inactive groups aren’t asked when ordering.
modifiers.optionsHint: With surcharge (incl. VAT, 0 = none), allergens and translations.
modifiers.noPricePermission: Changing surcharges requires the “Change prices” permission.
modifiers.allergensHint: Apply in addition to the product’s allergens when the option is chosen.
modifiers.translationsHint: The name is the catalogue text; an empty language shows it.
modifiers.groupTranslationsHint: Name “{name}” in other languages for the QR menu and web.
